status: choices frozen with verified tuning/calibration in configs/frozen_experiment_protocol.json; full experiments pending
scope: eight-arm local development experiments; full eleven-arm reproduction remains a separate unresolved target
stream_order: preserve original stream_position within each existing phase; MMLU filters task prefix mmlu- without resplitting
replicate_interpretation: retrain preference projection/prior per seed, then use common contexts for every method in that replicate; policy RNG also uses the replicate seed; partitions and stream order stay fixed

pretraining.holdout_use: initialization coefficients only; no parameter selection or early stopping

tuning_scope: select separately for routerbench and filtered MMLU tuning subsets, then reuse selected parameters across all replicate seeds
learning_fraction_rule: ceil(fraction * learning_count), nested prefixes of the unchanged learning stream
budget_reference_rule: mean estimated tuning query cost of reference arm multiplied by deployment query count
ratio_bounds_rule: shared per dataset: LB=0.5*minimum and UB=2*maximum positive prequential score/cost ratio from selected tuning candidates
aggregation: paired per-seed summaries; seed variation is descriptive and not a confidence interval over new datasets
resource_policy: one heavy command and one worker; require at least 8 GiB available physical RAM before start; no paid API requests
ablation_inventory_status: five controlled variants frozen before full deployment outcomes; 240 additional runs, 1098 primary plus ablation runs; execution pending
